title: Lesson 1: Welcome!
summary: Let's Learn English is a 52-lesson course for beginning English learners. This week, Anna moves to Washington, DC. She meets Pete at her new apartment.
content_md:

Speaking Practice
Pronunciation
Conversation
Pete: Hi! Are you Anna?
Anna: Yes! Hi there! Are you Pete?
Pete: I am Pete.
Anna: Nice to meet you.
Anna: Let's try that again. I'm Anna. Nice to meet you.
Pete: I'm Pete. "Anna" Is that A-N-A?
Anna: No. A-N-N-A
Pete: Well, Anna with two "n's" ... Welcome to ... 1400 Irving Street!
Anna: My new apartment! Yes!
